categories.main_business_segments: Harvatek primarily engages in the research, development, design, manufacturing, and testing of surface mount device light-emitting diodes (SMD LEDs). The company also conducts import and export trade of these products. Its product portfolio includes SMD LEDs for consumer electronics, communication devices, automotive lighting, small-pitch displays, wearable applications, and UV sterilization modules.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes semiconductor packaging technologies focusing on SMD LED packaging, including advanced techniques such as flip chip, Mini LED, Micro LED, RGB+IC integration, and IC packaging. Manufacturing processes include die bonding, wire bonding, molding, sawing, testing, and taping. Harvatek also invests in process improvements to enhance luminous efficiency, brightness, and cost reduction.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Harvatek serves key customers in consumer electronics, automotive, communication, industrial instrumentation, and display industries. Major end markets include smartphone backlighting, smart home appliances, automotive intelligent lighting and displays, gaming peripherals, small-pitch LED displays, wearable devices, and UV sterilization applications. The company maintains relationships with global OEMs and tier-one customers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in Taiwan with headquarters and manufacturing facilities in Hsinchu. It has subsidiaries and investments in Hong Kong, the United States, Germany, and mainland China, including Guangzhou and Yangzhou. Sales are distributed across Asia, Europe, and the Americas, with a significant portion of revenue generated from Asian markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Harvatek operates mainly in the downstream segment of the LED supply chain, focusing on LED packaging and module assembly. It sources upstream materials such as LED dice and PCBs from external suppliers and provides finished LED components and modules to OEMs and system integrators. The company also extends into IC packaging, bridging semiconductor packaging with LED technologies.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in Mini LED, Micro LED, RGB+IC integration, VCSEL, and IC packaging technologies. It aims to improve product luminous efficiency, brightness, and reliability while reducing material costs. Harvatek is expanding into high-margin markets such as automotive lighting, wearable sensors, and UV sterilization. It also emphasizes process innovation, production yield enhancement, and supply chain partnerships to strengthen its competitive position.
categories.revenue_model: Harvatek generates revenue primarily through product sales of LED components and modules. It also earns income from engineering integration services and licensing agreements, such as white LED patent licensing from OSRAM. The company receives dividends and investment income from subsidiaries and associates. Revenue is recognized upon product delivery and transfer of control to customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include Japanese firms Nichia, Citizen, and Rohm, as well as domestic Taiwanese companies like Everlight, Lextar, and Lextar Electronics. Harvatek holds a significant position in Taiwan's LED packaging industry with a comprehensive product line and strong R&D capabilities. It differentiates itself through advanced packaging technologies and strategic partnerships, maintaining competitiveness against large international players.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2022, Harvatek reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$2.47 billion, a 17.7% decrease from the prior year, with a net profit attributable to owners of NT$375 million and earnings per share of NT$1.82. The company maintains a solid asset base of around NT$4.08 billion and equity of NT$3.36 billion. Despite revenue decline, profitability remains stable with improved gross margins and positive cash flows from operations. The company continues investing in R&D and capital expenditures to support growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Harvatek emphasizes a comprehensive and innovative product portfolio with rapid R&D cycles averaging three months to market. It offers one-stop shopping for customers with a wide range of SMD LED products and modules, ensuring high quality and cost-effective solutions. The company leverages advanced packaging technologies, strict quality control, and strategic supply chain collaborations to deliver reliable, high-performance LED components tailored to diverse applications including automotive, consumer electronics, and industrial markets.
